record.question: In an overhead transmission line system, a ground wire (earth wire) is installed above phase conductors. What is the primary purpose of providing this ground wire?
options: To carry load current through an additional conductor during normal system operation
To reduce the overall electrical resistance of the transmission line conductors
To protect the transmission line against lightning surges by diverting them to earth
To improve voltage regulation of the line by minimizing voltage drop along the route
